finding.summary: Concrete ViewDataDictionary iteration is forced through interface-returning enumerators.
finding.explanation: ViewDataDictionary exposes only explicit IEnumerable<T> and IEnumerable GetEnumerator implementations. Concrete foreach therefore cannot bind to a public pattern-based enumerator, and returning the underlying dictionary enumerator as IEnumerator<T> can box its struct enumerator on the per-request view-data path.
